newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservative Eurosceptics call press conference.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservative Eurosceptics call press conference.

text.p: A group of Eurosceptic Conservative members of parliament has called a news conference for 1130 gmt, an aide to one of the MPs, Sir Teddy Taylor, said on Monday.
The group consists of the nine legislators who were temporarily expelled from the parliamentary party last year for refusing to back Prime Minister John Major in a vote on Europe.
Major on Sunday reiterated his wait-and-see stance on a single European currency, to the dismay of a section of his party.
The aide said the news conference had been arranged by Teresa Gorman. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
